_note: The first release with `featured: true` drives the homepage hero, /music, and the EPK. `status` is 'upcoming' or 'released'; before release, links are shown as pre-save links. Empty urls are hidden. `artwork` is the web-size image (null falls back to the band logo); `artworkHiRes` is the print/press download shown on the EPK. `video.url` supports YouTube watch/short/youtu.be links; null hides the video section. `releaseShowId` points to an id in shows.json. `type` is single, ep, or album. `audio` is a path under /public to a streamable file for the on-site player (null hides it). `artworkCredit` {name, url} is shown under the cover and in the lightbox caption (null hides it). `creditsId` references a block in credits.json. `tracklist` is [{title, duration, lyrics}] — lyrics as a plain string with \n line breaks (blank line between verses). Tracks with empty lyrics still list; the Lyrics row hides if no track has lyrics. Each track may have `audio`; a release with 2+ playable tracks renders the multi-track player, otherwise the single-track player uses `audio` on the release. Mark a track `instrumental: true` to label it as having no lyrics.
